subject: Reset all settings
body: I want to restore my TV's settings to the factory defaults. Where do I do that?

subject: Connect Bluetooth headphones
body: How do I connect my Bluetooth headphones so I can watch TV at night without waking the family?

subject: Pair a new remote
body: I bought a spare remote. How do I pair it with my TV?

subject: TV does not turn on
body: My TV does not turn on at all since this morning. I changed the batteries in the remote and it still does nothing. It is a present for my father's birthday tomorrow, please help.

subject: Voices do not match the lips
body: I watch with Bluetooth headphones in the evening. After a few minutes the voices lag behind the picture and sometimes the sound drops out. Can I fix this?

subject: No sound from my soundbar
body: I connected a new soundbar with an HDMI cable yesterday. The picture is fine but the soundbar plays nothing. The soundbar is switched on.

subject: Phone does not find TV
body: I want to show my phone screen on the TV but the TV does not appear in the app. Both should be on Wi-Fi. We have a guest network at home, if that matters.

subject: Turn on from my phone
body: Is there a way to switch the TV on with my phone through the network?

subject: Change sound mode
body: Where do I change the sound mode? I want to try the Amplify mode.

subject: Remote reacts late
body: My remote only works if I stand right in front of the TV, and sometimes a button press is missed. New batteries did not help. Is it broken?

subject: Black and white screen option
body: I want the TV to show everything in grayscale for a family member who finds colours hard to read. Where do I find that?

subject: 5 GHz network not listed
body: My router has two networks, a normal one and one with 5G at the end, but the TV only shows the normal one. Streaming is slow on it. How do I get the faster one?

subject: Brightness changes by itself
body: The picture gets darker and brighter on its own, mostly in dark films. I did not change anything. Is the TV broken?

subject: Invert colours
body: How can I invert the screen colours? A family member finds the text easier to read that way.

subject: Name the HDMI inputs
body: I have three devices on the TV and I cannot tell the inputs apart. Can I give each input its own name?

subject: USB hard drive not found
body: I connected my external hard drive through a USB hub but the TV does not show it. A small flash drive works. Why?

subject: Laptop shows Not Supported Mode
body: I connected my laptop with an HDMI cable and the TV shows Not Supported Mode. What does that mean and what can I do?

subject: Green tint on the picture
body: There is a green tint on the whole screen. I changed a few picture settings last week to try a film mode. How do I get back to normal?

subject: Use a USB keyboard
body: I would like to use a normal USB keyboard for typing searches. Do I just plug it in? Does a mouse work too?

subject: Vertical line on screen
body: A thin vertical line appeared on the left side of my screen. It is visible on every input, also in the menu. I cleaned the screen with a dry cloth. What can I do?

subject: Favourite channels
body: How can I make a list of my favourite channels, so that I do not have to scroll through all of them?

subject: TV is very slow
body: The menu reacts after several seconds and sometimes the TV freezes for a moment when I open apps. It used to be fast. I have a lot of apps installed.

subject: TV switches off alone
body: The TV turns off after a few hours while I am watching, without warning. I do not think I set a timer. What could cause this?

subject: App closes by itself
body: The video app on my TV closes and sends me back to the home screen after a minute. Other apps are fine. I already restarted the TV once.

subject: Show subtitles
body: How do I turn on subtitles for digital channels and change how they look?

subject: Turn TV off automatically
body: Can the TV switch itself off after a while when nobody is watching? Where is that setting?

subject: Scheduled recording did not start
body: I scheduled a recording of a film but nothing was recorded. I had a USB stick connected. What went wrong?

subject: Voice search does not answer
body: I hold the microphone button and speak but nothing happens. The picture and apps work normally. How can I fix voice search?

subject: Test the speakers
body: The sound from my TV sometimes crackles. Is there a way to test the speakers on the TV itself, to see whether the TV or my cable box is the problem?

subject: Check the picture on the TV
body: The picture from my cable box looks odd. How can I find out whether the TV itself is the problem?

subject: Takes forever to start
body: When I switch the TV on it takes more than a minute until I see the picture, and then the home screen pops up by itself. Can this be made faster?

subject: TV will not connect to Wi-Fi
body: My TV says the wireless network connection failed. My phone works fine on the same Wi-Fi and I already switched the router off and on. This is really annoying.

subject: Lower the backlight
body: Where do I change the backlight of the TV? Watching in the evening hurts my eyes.

subject: Connect my phone app to the TV
body: I installed the Smart Tech Home app on my phone. How do I connect it to my TV?

subject: Browse the web on the TV
body: Can I look at websites on my TV? Where do I find the browser?

subject: Connect an external hard drive
body: I want to watch videos from an external hard drive. What do I need to know before I plug it into the TV?

subject: Speak instead of typing
body: When the on-screen keyboard is open, can I speak into the remote instead of typing the letters?

subject: Set clock manually
body: The TV shows the wrong time. Where do I set the current time?

subject: Picture cut off at the edges
body: On some channels the picture is cut off at the edges. Is there a setting that fits the picture to the screen?

subject: Rename TV on network
body: I have two TVs at home and cannot tell them apart in the app. Can I give mine a different name?
